# DS4420 Final Project Bayesian Model
### Sophia Yang, Veronica Song, Alina Gonzalez
## Objective 
We created a Bayesian predictive model that predicts the likelihood of pet adoption based on the animal’s identified key traits.

## Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
set.seed(42)
library(brms)
library(forcats)
library(pROC)
```

## Read Data
```{r read}
pets <- read.csv("pet_adoption_data.csv")
head(pets)
```

## Quick Data Checks
```{r checks}
table(pets$AdoptionLikelihood, useNA = "ifany")

model_cols <- c(
  "AdoptionLikelihood", "AgeMonths", "Breed", "PetType", "HealthCondition",
  "Vaccinated", "AdoptionFee", "TimeInShelterDays", "PreviousOwner", "WeightKg"
)
missing_cols <- setdiff(model_cols, names(pets))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
colSums(is.na(pets[model_cols]))
```

## Preprocess

```{r preprocess}
pets_scaled <- pets 
pets_scaled$Breed <- fct_lump(as.factor(pets$Breed), n = 5)

# numeric features get scaled
pets_scaled$AgeMonths <- as.numeric(scale(pets$AgeMonths))
pets_scaled$AdoptionFee <- as.numeric(scale(pets$AdoptionFee))
pets_scaled$WeightKg <- as.numeric(scale(pets$WeightKg))
pets_scaled$TimeInShelterDays <- as.numeric(scale(pets$TimeInShelterDays))

# categorical features
pets_scaled$PetType <- as.factor(pets$PetType)
pets_scaled$HealthCondition <- as.factor(pets$HealthCondition)
pets_scaled$Vaccinated <- as.factor(pets$Vaccinated)
pets_scaled$PreviousOwner <- as.factor(pets$PreviousOwner)

# check Bernoulli outcome
stopifnot(all(pets_scaled$AdoptionLikelihood %in% c(0, 1)))
```

## Fit Bayes Model
```{r bayes model}
n_chains <- 4
n_iter <- 2000
n_warmup <- 1000

# stronger priors might help..?
prior <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept")
)

# try taking out breed
model <- brm(
  AdoptionLikelihood ~ AgeMonths + PetType + HealthCondition + Vaccinated +
    AdoptionFee + TimeInShelterDays + PreviousOwner + WeightKg + (1 | Breed)
  ,
  family = bernoulli("logit"),
  data = pets_scaled,
  chains = n_chains,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 42,
  warmup = n_warmup,
  iter = n_iter,
  refresh = 100,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.99,
    max_treedepth = 15
    )
)

saveRDS(model, "bayes_model_fit_4.rds")
```
